text:
Ruth: Quick sync — planning to push the 'compact-snippets' change for rn-slate on 2026-06-10 23:00 UTC. Draft RN here: https://internal/redwood/rn/compact-snippets-2026-06-10.md. Canary in us-east, then eu. Need pin owner, rollback owner, and internal blurb owner.

Mateo: I can take pinning and rollout. Target image rn-slate:v2.4.0-quant. I'll stage by 22:30 UTC.

Ivy: Ops asks for a 12m canary in us-east-1 then 15m in eu-west-1. Auto-rollout should stop if error_rate > 1.6% or p95 > baseline * 1.28. Fallback: v2.3.5. I'll draft the ops runbook and link it.

Ruth: RN needs explicit rollback snippet, contact list (oncall + eng-sre + product), and an explicit cost bullet. Also request a one-sentence internal blurb for fast posting.

Mateo: Rollback snippet added to RN and ops-note:
```
# rollback to last-known-good
/deploy rn-slate --image=rn-slate:v2.3.5 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: perf or errors"
```

OpsBot: Suggested smoke checks: GET /_health -> 200; POST /v1/generate with prompt "smoke" assert tokens <= 130 and latency < 450ms.

Ivy: I'll wire those into the CI smoke jobs and put the runbook at ops-runbooks/rn-slate-canary.md, linking to the RN.

Zoe: I'll write the internal blurb. Proposed: "Deploying compact-snippets to reduce token usage; monitoring latency and error rates during canary. Contact eng-oncall for regressions." Approve?

Ruth: LGTM. Add the brief cost delta: approx -0.4 tok/op.

Mateo: Deploy command for the runbook and for Sam to stage:
```
/deploy rn-slate --image=rn-slate:v2.4.0-quant --env=prod --canary=12m --pin=false
```

DeployBot: deploy started at 1812345700 (status: canary running)  https://deployboard/redwood/1812345700

Ivy: Canary first 6m: p95 +9%, error_rate 0.3%. Smoke tests passing.

Mateo: Good so far. Expanding to eu-west at 23:12 UTC.

DeployBot: expanded canary to eu-west at 1812345740 (status: canary expanded).

Ivy: eu-west had a small 502 spike on two hosts; autoscaler restarted them and health recovered. No sustained errors.

Mateo: Given recovery, advance to pin stage: pinning to 60% and will observe for 10m.

DeployBot: partial pin applied at 1812345760 (pin=60%).

Zoe: Posting internal blurb to docs/announce-drafts/compact-snippets-internal.txt and prepping to post to #eng 10m after we hit 100% rollout.

Ivy: Ops final watch window started. p95 within +7% baseline, error_rate steady at 0.5%.

DeployBot: rollout completed at 1812345790 (status: success, rollout 100%). Summary: us-east 12m -> eu-west 15m -> staggered expansion -> 100% complete.

Ruth: Great work. Reminder: update external RN with rollback and cost bullets before any customer-facing message. Zoe will post to #eng and Mateo will pin the version in console.

Mateo: Pinned v2.4.0-quant to the prod route in console. \u2705

Zoe: Posting to #eng and #customer-success now with the short impact line and runbook link.

Ivy: Closing runbook and tagging owners. If anything regresses, run the rollback command and escalate to #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:

Ruth: Thanks team, closing thread.
